name: National Fellowship for Higher Education of ST Students

rules.name: Mandatory ST Caste Category
rules.public_explanation: Applicant category does not confirm Scheduled Tribe status on uploaded certificate.

rules.name: Applicant Name Cross-Verification
rules.public_explanation: The name on the certificate differs from the name submitted in the application.

rules.name: Maximum Age Threshold (36 Years for ST)
rules.public_explanation: Age exceeds the 36-year upper limit applicable for NFST candidates.

rules.name: Annual Family Income Ceiling
rules.public_explanation: Annual family income exceeds the ceiling of ₹6,00,000 per annum.

rules.name: Regular Full-Time Doctoral Enrollment
rules.public_explanation: Only candidates admitted into regular, full-time M.Phil or Ph.D programs are eligible.
